The outer cover is first, followed by the opened invitation (English on the left, Telugu on the right). Click any maroon text to change it. Artwork is decorative; no reference couple names are copied.

For permanent GitHub changes, click Download edited HTML for GitHub and replace your repository's index.html with the downloaded file. All floral artwork is embedded in this one HTML file. Please verify the small Telugu text before printing.
